{"sql": "WITH base AS (

              WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS q,

  JOIN products p USING(product_id)
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
    AND p.product_category_name = 'informatica_acessorios'

  SELECT q, sum(price) AS gmv, count(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders, count(*) AS items
  FROM base GROUP BY q

         max(orders) FILTER (WHERE q='Q1') AS o1, max(orders) FILTER (WHERE q='Q2') AS o2,
         max(items) FILTER (WHERE q='Q1') AS i1, max(items) FILTER (WHERE q='Q2') AS i2
  FROM agg
)
SELECT round(g2-g1,2) AS gmv_diff,
       round((o2-o1)*(g1/o1),2) AS order_volume_effect,

       round((g2/i2-(g1/i1))/(g1/i1),4) AS avg_item_price_change_rate,
       round(i1::numeric/o1,4) AS items_per_order_q1,
       round(i2::numeric/o2,4) AS items_per_order_q2
FROM p;"}
